package sandbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
)

// CombinedClient combines HTTP and NATS clients for sandbox access.
type CombinedClient struct {
	httpClient *Client
	natsClient *nats.SandboxClient
}

// NewCombinedClient creates a combined sandbox client.
func NewCombinedClient(httpBaseURL, httpToken string, natsClient *nats.SandboxClient) *CombinedClient {
	return &CombinedClient{
		httpClient: NewClient(httpBaseURL, httpToken),
		natsClient: natsClient,
	}
}

// GetSnapshot fetches workspace files snapshot via HTTP.
func (c *CombinedClient) GetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) (WorkspaceSnapshot, error) {
	return c.httpClient.GetSnapshot(ctx, sandboxID)
}

// FindByUserAndTask finds sandbox ID by user, task, and answer via HTTP.
func (c *CombinedClient) FindByUserAndTask(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string) (string, error) {
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/sandboxes?user_id=%s&task_id=%s&answer_id=%s", c.httpClient.BaseURL, userID, taskID, answerID)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if c.httpClient.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.httpClient.InternalToken)
	}

	resp, err := c.httpClient.HTTPClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return "", domain.ErrSandboxNotFound
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("find sandbox failed: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var result struct {
		SandboxID string `json:"sandboxId"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return result.SandboxID, nil
}

// ArchiveAndUpload requests archive and upload via NATS.
func (c *CombinedClient) ArchiveAndUpload(ctx context.Context, sandboxID, answerID string) (string, error) {
	// Prefer NATS RPC when available, fallback to HTTP internal endpoint when there are no subscribers.
	if c.natsClient != nil {
		if id, err := c.natsClient.ArchiveAndUpload(ctx, sandboxID, answerID); err == nil {
			return id, nil
		}
	}
	return c.archiveAndUploadHTTP(ctx, sandboxID, answerID)
}

func (c *CombinedClient) archiveAndUploadHTTP(ctx context.Context, sandboxID, answerID string) (string, error) {
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/sandboxes/%s/archive-and-upload", c.httpClient.BaseURL, sandboxID)
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"answerId": answerID})
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if c.httpClient.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.httpClient.InternalToken)
	}

	resp, err := c.httpClient.HTTPClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("archive/upload failed: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var result struct {
		FileStorageID string `json:"fileStorageId"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if result.FileStorageID == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("archive/upload response missing fileStorageId")
	}
	return result.FileStorageID, nil
}
